items.source: Additional constructor with the session id for each targetDestination.
items.translation: 带有每个目标目的地会话 ID 的附加构造函数。

items.source: Return the session id for the targetDestination.
items.translation: 返回目标目的地 (targetDestination) 的会话 ID。

items.source:
The user destination in the form expected when a client subscribes, for example,
"/user/queue/position-updates".
items.translation: 客户端订阅时表单中预期的用户目标，例如 "/user/queue/position-updates"。

items.source:
The target destinations that the source destination was translated to,
one per active user session, for example, "/queue/position-updates-useri9oqdfzo".
items.translation: 源目标被翻译到的目标目的地，每个活动用户会话一个，例如"/queue/position-updates-useri9oqdfzo"。

items.source: The user for this user destination.

The "user" destination from the source message. This may look like
"/user/queue/position-updates" when subscribing or
"/user/{username}/queue/position-updates" when sending a message.
items.translation: 源消息中的"user"目标。订阅时可能看起来像"/user/queue/position-updates"，而发送消息时可能为"/user/{username}/queue/position-updates"。

items.source: the user name or null if we have a session id only such as when the user is not authenticated; in such cases it is possible to use sessionId in place of a user name thus removing the need for a user-to-session lookup via SimpUserRegistry.
items.translation: 用户名为 `null`，如果仅拥有会话 ID（例如用户未通过身份验证）；在这种情况下，可以使用 sessionId 代替用户名，从而无需通过 SimpUserRegistry 进行用户到会话的查找。

items.source: the target destinations, never null but possibly an empty set if there are no active sessions for the user.
items.translation: 目标目的地，永远不会是 `null`，但如果用户没有活动会话，则可能是一个空集。

items.source: the subscribe form of the "user" destination, never null.
items.translation: "user" 目的地的订阅表单，永远不为null。

items.source:
Contains the result from parsing a "user" destination from a source message
and translating it to target destinations (one per active user session).
items.translation: 包含从源消息解析"user"目的地并将其转换为目标目的地（每个活动用户会话一个）的结果。

items.source: The "user" destination from the source message.

items.translation: `toString` 在类 `Object` 中
